subject: Billing update & VAT classification following Crescent / Meridian close
messages:
From: Sara Patel <sara.patel@crescenthealth.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Cc: Oliver Gomez <ogomez@crescentfinance.com>
Date: 2026-10-25T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Transitioning invoicing after Meridian acquisition

Hi Evelyn,

Quick intro — I’m Sara (head of finance at Crescent). Meridian closed last week and our legal entity will consolidate under "Crescent Health Holdings, Inc." starting 2026-11-01. We need Redwood to:

- Redirect invoices to the new remit address (see below).
- Update legal name on POs and invoices.
- Confirm VAT treatment for EU subsidiaries (we have operations in IE and DE).

Prelim remit info: Crescent Health Holdings, Inc. | EFT acct details on request | Remit: AP@crescenthealth.com | New billing address: 420 Harbor Ave, Suite 120, Boston, MA 02110

I attached the acquisition memo for context. Can you confirm what you need from us (W-9, tax IDs, PO updates)? Also please advise if the legal-name change will cause any interruption to collections / automated payments.

Thanks,
Sara
Sara Patel
Head of Finance — Crescent Health
Attachment: Crescent_Acquisition_Memo.pdf (pdf, 48KB)
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
To: Sara Patel <sara.patel@crescenthealth.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-26T09:43:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Transitioning invoicing after Meridian acquisition

Hi Sara — welcome and congrats on the close.

Short answers up front:
- We can change invoice legal name and remit address with no billing interruption, provided we receive the new legal entity name, tax ID (EIN/VAT as applicable), and the AP contact.
- For EU VAT: we need the VAT registration number for the Irish and German entities to apply reverse-charge vs. VAT on invoices.
- For ACH/EFT: our collections team needs the remittance email plus bank-auth docs for auto-pull changes.

Marcus is going to draft a billing transition matrix and Priyom will outline the docs we need from Crescent finance. Can you confirm the effective date for the change — you mentioned 2026-11-01? If so, we’ll plan invoices dated on/after Nov 1 to use the new legal name.

One ask: please send the W-9 for the new holding entity and the VAT numbers for the EMEA entities.

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Senior Manager, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Sara Patel <sara.patel@crescenthealth.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-02T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Billing transition matrix + VAT questions

Sara — looping in Laura from Billing Ops. I’ve attached a billing matrix that lays out the items we need and the impact on open invoices / autopay. Highlights:

- Open invoices dated before 2026-11-01 will be left as-is unless you request reissue. Reissuing can delay collections by up to 7 business days.
- All invoices issued on/after 2026-11-01 will show "Crescent Health Holdings, Inc." as the billed-to entity.
- For EU entities with VAT regs: if you provide a valid VAT ID, we will apply reverse charge (0% VAT) and include your VAT ID on the invoice. If no VAT ID is provided, VAT will be charged at the local rate.
- Auto-pay (ACH): to switch remit email for ACH pull, we need a signed remittance change form and confirmation of the bank account owner name.

Attachment: updated_billing_matrix.xlsx (xlsx, 12KB)

Questions for Crescent:
1) Do you want open AR reissued to the new entity or keep as-is and let new invoices reflect the new name?
2) Can you share the VAT numbers for IE and DE entities?
3) Do you have a PO number series that should be appended to future invoices?

Thanks — Marcus
Marcus Lin
Director, Billing Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Miriam Kaplan <miriam.kaplan@elliotpartners.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>, Sara Patel <sara.patel@crescenthealth.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-09T14:22:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Transitioning invoicing after Meridian acquisition

Evelyn / Sara — small clarifying note from counsel: Crescent would like Redwood to accept the holding company name on invoices but keep the subsidiary names on the service schedules where liability sits (example: "Crescent Health Holdings, Inc. (on behalf of Crescent Health Services Ltd.)"). Are you able to support dual-entity invoice language?

Also attaching a redline to the MSA billing contact clause — we propose language that explicitly authorizes the holding company to receive invoices and remit payment.

Attachment: MSA_billing_contact_redline.pdf (pdf, 9KB)

—Miriam Kaplan
Elliot Partners — M&A Counsel
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Sara Patel <sara.patel@crescenthealth.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-12T10:17:00-08:00
Subject: Documents required for remittance change and tax compliance

Sara — thanks for the memo and Miriam’s redline. To make the switch cleanly we need the following by 2026-11-24 (two business days before effective date if you want Nov 1 activation):

1) W-9 for Crescent Health Holdings, Inc. (EIN) — PDF, signed.
2) VAT registration numbers for: Crescent Health Ireland (IE) and Crescent Health Germany (DE).
3) Signed remittance change form (attached template) authorizing AP@crescenthealth.com and the new bank account for ACH pulls.
4) Confirmation if you want existing open invoices reissued or left as historical liabilities of Meridian. If reissued, please provide PO mapping.

I’ve attached a remittance template and included suggested invoice language that supports the holding / subsidiary phrasing Miriam mentioned. If you can return items 1–3 we’ll queue the billing system changes and schedule a one-hour cutover window to update autopay.

Attachments: remittance_instructions_v2.docx (docx, 6KB)

Best,
Priyom Das
Senior Manager, Finance Ops (Redwood Inference)
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
To: Sara Patel <sara.patel@crescenthealth.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>

Date: 2026-11-18T16:04:00-08:00
Subject: Confirmed: action items & cutover plan for Crescent billing change (Nov 1)

Team — thanks for the quick responses. Summary / next steps:  

- Crescent to provide: W-9 (holding co), VAT IDs (IE & DE), signed remittance form, and PO mapping if they want invoices reissued. Target delivery: 2026-10-28 (Sara indicated some docs available) — if anything slips let us know.
- Redwood will: prepare invoice template with dual-entity language; schedule billing system change for 2026-11-01 00:00 UTC; if Crescent confirms reissue request we will reissue open invoices on 2026-11-01 during the cutover window (may delay collections by up to 7 business days).
- Priyom will own collections & ACH transition, Marcus will own invoice template and reissues, Laura will monitor the AR ledger and holdback exceptions.

Final ask for Crescent: please return the three docs to finance@redwood.com and sign the DocuSign packet we’ll send (DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/packet/ABC-1234). Once we receive those items we’ll confirm the cutover time and share the final invoice previews.

Evelyn Hart
Senior Manager, Revenue Operations
